desc:
🏨 Welcome to Teardown the Hotel! 💥
The guests have checked out — now it’s your turn to destroy everything inside!
Grab your tools, plant explosives, and reduce a luxury hotel to dust with realistic physics and total freedom.

💣 What you can do:

Smash rooms, hallways, and entire floors! 🔨

Use TNT, vehicles, or sledgehammers to cause chaos 🚧

Watch realistic destruction physics in action 🧱

Explore before you blow it all up 👀

Will you leave a single wall standing?
🔥 Play now and unleash your inner demolisher!
